summary: Verified the new Inspire Me feature end-to-end. Backend POST /api/inspire returns valid 4-10 recipes with full schema (yield_text, ingredients_detailed, nutrition, etc.) for all 5 categories, rejects invalid category with 400, and accepts the optional coach hint. Regression on /api/ask-recipes and /api/suggest still green. Frontend /inspire renders tabs, grid of ~8 cards, per-category caching (no reload spinner switching back), Shuffle reloads, card click navigates to /recipe/:idx showing the yield pill + detailed ingredients. Bottom nav is 7 tabs including 'Inspire'; desktop top-nav 'Coach' now appears exactly once. With a Coach profile (gain/weights), the 'Personalized using your Coach targets' badge shows and recipes trend high-protein (>=3 of 8 with >=25g protein confirmed).
critical_code_review_comments: InspireMe.jsx `load` callback depends on `byCategory`, which means the effect will run again if state changes upstream, but the guard `if (!force && (byCategory[cat] || []).length > 0) return;` prevents re-fetch — behavior is correct but slightly non-obvious.

readCoachHint() falls back to `{goal: p.goal}` if age/height/weight are missing — the `coachOn` flag is only set true when target_kcal is truthy, so the personalization badge won't show for partial profiles. Fine as designed.
server.py inspire endpoint clamps count to [4,10] — matches spec. No dedup of near-duplicates on the server side; relies fully on the LLM prompt. Occasional duplicates possible but rare.

Personalization is LLM-guided (prompt hint) — the >=3 recipes >=25g protein criterion may fail intermittently on certain shuffles for lighter categories (breakfast tended to sit at 20-25g on first pull). Not a bug, just flaky. Consider explicitly requesting a protein floor in the prompt when goal==gain.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 6 inspire flows: render, tabs, cache, shuffle, card->detail, coach personalization)

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_inspire.py at /app/backend/tests/ covers all 5 categories + invalid + coach hint. LLM calls take ~30s each so total inspire suite is ~3.5min. Frontend testing sets localStorage keys `manifeast_coach_profile` and clears `manifeast_inspire_cache` between runs. Grid uses opacity-50 wrapper while loading — wait for that class to clear before clicking cards.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — this iteration validated a new feature, not a bug fix.
